title: Declare macOS 14+ as the supported floor - the pip set already requires it
description: MEASURED 2026-08-30 (MPI-249 check 2, answered from Windows with uv): the curated pip set cannot install on an arm64 Mac below macOS 14. Two packages set it - bitsandbytes 0.50.2 (only Mac wheel macosx_14_0_arm64, from MPI-607) and embreex 4.4.0 (macosx_13_0_arm64, shipped since MPI-413, and its platform_machine != aarch64 marker never excluded Apple Silicon because macOS reports arm64). Electron's own floor is Ventura 13, so OUR floor is one release stricter and the pip set is what sets it. Chasing 13 means un-pinning trimesh[easy]'s extra AND downgrading bitsandbytes - two downgrades on every platform. Fabio's call 2026-08-30: declare 14+. Every Apple Silicon Mac (M1, 2020+) can run 14/15/26, so no supported machine is stuck below it; macOS 26 Tahoe is at 86% share and Ventura is a rounding error. Docs only - no marker change, no code gate.
